sentences.en: I could go for a nice hot pizza right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在很想吃一份热腾腾的比萨。

sentences.en: I don't like pizza any more than I like spaghetti.
sentences.zh: 我并不比讨厌意大利面更讨厌比萨。

sentences.en: While eating a pizza he was annoying his sister.
sentences.zh: 他一边吃着比萨还一边烦扰着他妹妹。

senses.zh: 比萨饼（一种涂有乳酪核番茄酱的意大利式有馅烘饼）
